data.one_liner: Creates native and Flutter splash screens with image support and dark‑mode handling.
data.what_it_does: Generates native splash screen resources from a simple pubspec.yaml configuration and provides a Flutter widget for displaying an image splash. Supports light/dark mode and Android 12+ splash settings.
use_when: You need a native splash screen that matches your Flutter app’s theme
You want a quick, config‑driven way to generate Android/iOS launch screens
You need built‑in dark‑mode support for splash screens
avoid_when: You require animated splash screens (use splash_master_rive/video/lottie)
You need highly custom native launch screen layouts beyond the provided options
strengths: Native splash generation from a single YAML config
Built‑in light and dark mode handling
weaknesses: Only image‑based splash; animations need separate packages
Limited customization compared to hand‑crafted native launch screens
data.setup_notes: Add splash_master to pubspec, define splash_master block with color and image, then run `dart run splash_master create` to generate native files.
